scope: Twenty paired original-name/source-field discovery diagnostics for Hong Kong monument records. Names are source facts, including original Traditional Chinese spellings. No human relevance labels, lifecycle claims, inferred points or declaration-year historical stages. These are not blind benchmarks or a complete archaeological inventory.
